what_was_proposed: Review round nine implemented and measured a corrected form of #1025's tolerance changes -- promote for LENGTH only, compare promoted-but-uncapped components EXACTLY, and bound a cap difference by the DIFFERENCE of the two arms' damage rather than 0.18x its magnitude. On 75,630 simulated realizable cap-bearing pairs it measured 99.99% recovery against 99.89% for the version that shipped, while rejecting both physically impossible pairs. I implemented exactly that design.

what_the_real_corpus_says.window: 200 games, seeds 19000000-19000199, 15,224 boundaries, engine rebuilt per state

the_finding: The corrected design is SOUND -- it rejects both impossible pairs, and all four of its rules are mutation-pinned -- but on real data it recovers only 15% of what the loose version recovered. The synthetic estimate of 99.99% did not transfer. A simulated corpus of realizable pairs is not the corpus the matcher actually sees.

which_explanation_is_right_is_NOT_establ.possibility_a: the 120 unrecovered rows are REAL engine defects that the loose version was masking, in which case the sound version is correct and 67 was never an honest number
which_explanation_is_right_is_NOT_establ.possibility_b: the exact-magnitude rule is firing on MISPAIRED components. Promotion moves a component out of the order-insensitive Counter comparison into roll_component_events_agree's POSITIONAL zip, which sorts by magnitude; review flagged this as a known hazard of promotion. If pairing is wrong, the magnitudes being compared are not counterparts at all.
which_explanation_is_right_is_NOT_establ.how_to_decide: dump the promoted-uncapped pairs the exact rule rejects and check whether each pair is a genuine counterpart. Possibility (b) predicts systematically mismatched sources; (a) predicts matched sources with small magnitude differences.

status: #1025 IS NOT READY. Do not merge it on the strength of the round-nine simulation. The sound version is in the branch with its pins, and this artifact records that its real-data effect is 15% of what was projected.
what_this_does_not_change: the load-bearing measurement stands: without any of these changes the window is 208 divergent, so they cannot simply be deleted either. Neither the loose version nor the sound version is the answer yet.
